findings.title: Potential StringIndexOutOfBoundsException when computing diff for prefix/suffix overlapping strings
findings.body: In `verifySafeHtml()`, when `value` and `sanitized` share both a common prefix and a common suffix that overlap (for example, `value = "<b><b>"` and `sanitized = "<b>"`, or `value = "a<x>a"` and `sanitized = "aa"`), `start` and `end` are incremented independently without checking `start + end <= Math.min(value.length(), sanitized.length())`. As a result, `start` can exceed `value.length() - end` or `sanitized.length() - end`, causing `substring(start, ... - end)` on line 111 to throw a `StringIndexOutOfBoundsException` instead of reporting the validation error. Guard the second `while` loop with `start + end < sanitized.length() && start + end < value.length()`.

findings.title: `ANCHOR_PATTERN` matches any HTML tag starting with `a`, not just `<a>` tags
findings.body: `ANCHOR_PATTERN` is defined as `Pattern.compile("</?a[^>]*>")`, which matches any tag whose name begins with `a` (such as `<applet>`, `<audio>`, `<area>`, `<article>`, or `<aside>`), not only anchor tags. Those tags will be processed by `santizeAnchors` rather than the HTML policy, producing misleading error messages ("Didn't find anchor tag <audio>...") or stripping them if they happen to match. The regex should require a word boundary or whitespace/closing bracket after `a`, e.g. `</?a(?:\s[^>]*)?>`.

findings.title: i18next message in Account UI replaced with Java MessageFormat syntax
findings.body: In `js/apps/account-ui/.../messages_en.properties` (and `js/apps/admin-ui/.../messages_en.properties`), `error-invalid-multivalued-size` was changed from i18next interpolation syntax (`Attribute {{0}} must have at least {{1}} and at most {{2}} value(s).`) to Java `MessageFormat` / `ChoiceFormat` syntax (`Attribute {0} must have at least {1} and at most {2} {2,choice,0#values|1#value|1<values}.`). The React-based account-ui and admin-ui use i18next (note every other key in these files uses `{{...}}`), which does not support Java `MessageFormat` single-brace placeholders or `choice` formats, so placeholders will render literally as `{0}`, `{1}`, `{2}` in the UI.

findings.title: Lithuanian translation replaced with Italian text
findings.body: `totpStep1` in the Lithuanian account messages (`messages_lt.properties`, line 101) and `loginTotpStep1` in the Lithuanian login messages (`themes/src/main/resources-community/theme/base/login/messages/messages_lt.properties`, line 71) were replaced with `Installa una delle seguenti applicazioni sul tuo cellulare:`, which is Italian rather than Lithuanian.
